name: Top-of-Hour Calm Favourite
description: Crypto prices move most right after the top of each hour and least in the last 15 minutes before it. Kalshi prices every 15-minute window as if the coming move were equally big, so in the window that ends on the hour the side that's currently winning is a bit cheaper than it should be. A few minutes into that window, buy the favourite (65-90c) on BTC, ETH and SOL and hold to settlement.
hypothesis: Crypto vol has a minute-of-hour cycle (hourly candles, hourly TWAP/rebalancing, hourly expiries at :00): the :45->:00 quarter is the calmest of the hour (0.85-0.90x the hour's variance vs 1.10x for :00->:15, all coins, both halves). Kalshi prices all four quarter-hour windows off the same trailing vol, so it overprices the remaining move in the :45 window and the favourite is cheap. Losers: underdog buyers and quoting bots with no minute-of-hour prior. Wrong if: the favourite in :45 windows isn't positive at next real fills after fee in both halves on at least two coins, or the walk-forward isn't promising, or the lockbox loses.
